sentences.en: The new venture was financed by a group of entrepreneurs.
sentences.zh: 这家新企业由一群企业家出资。

sentences.en: My strong point is my philosophy - nothing ventured nothing gained.
sentences.zh: 我的强项是我的理念——不冒险就没有收获。

sentences.en: The directors were reluctant to undertake so risky a venture.
sentences.zh: 董事会对如此高风险的企业持犹豫态度。

senses.zh: 冒险旅行；（有风险的）企业
敢于冒险；小心地说（或做）；冒着失去……的风险
